findings.title: R19 protein check is further from the bar
findings.detail: Median P is 0.344, against 0.427 in sweep 14 and 0.403 in sweep-p08. P is lower by more than 0.05 in 9 of 15 runs against sweep 14, and in 9 of 15 against sweep-p08 on the same foundings. P delivered fell from 138 to 122 against p08. Carrion went from 18.8 to 11.2 (forage:P trips 33 to 16) and 'unknown' from 13.6 to 9.3, while eggs laid rose from 349 to 374. Prey P barely moved (86.8 to 83.2), so item 4 is not the visible cause. Each run makes only 0 to 8 carrion trips, so no single colony carries the drop. Not traced.

findings.title: sg #2 loses viability on a hand-over that was viable in p08
findings.detail: Same founding as p08 (4.868 gd, 11 workers). Carbohydrate fell from 9.6 to 2.7 on day 3: C delivered that day was 0.045, against 3.28 in p08. It reached 0 by doy 21. The colony had 1-2 tenders a day against 4-5 in p08 (tend 12.9 vs 32.5 worker-gd), and 1 of 6 forage:C trips succeeded. It also dug 21.6 worker-gd (p08: 4.1), making 6-23 pellets a day on days 4-11 with only one plan created (day 8). In year two it starved in the lapse: 17 workers fell to 7, 9 starved and the queen died, leaving 2 at the second winter. One chaotic run; what the diggers dig with no open plan was not traced.

findings.title: Year two: R34 not met; the five colonies shrink
findings.detail: R34: 3 of 5 reach 1.0 x (bar 4: we #2 1.18, cpv #1 1.35, pp #3 1.21) and 0 of 5 reach 1.5 x (bar 3). The five together went from 79 at winter 1 to 71 at the second winter (p08's long runs: 85 to 85). sg #2 and kd #3 both end with 2 workers. R22 spring check: 4 of 5, met. R22 day-15 check: 2 of 5. R24: met; the four colonies viable at winter lost 5-13 % in the lapse.

findings.title: kd #3 raises no worker in year one; larvae starve with protein in store
findings.detail: 0 eclosions from 29 eggs. 7 larvae starved on days 2-5 while 1.4-4.8 P stood in store and mean larval hunger was 0.70-0.97. Also lost: 10 eggs to flooding and 9 brood to hygiene. On the same founding p08 had 7 eclosions and 0 starved. Nurse target was 1-2 against a demand of 1.4-3.8 (9 workers, one chamber), and several nurses were counted outside any chamber.

findings.title: Workers crushed rose to 12
findings.detail: 12 workers crushed, against 8 in sweep 14 and 7 in p08 (0-3 a run). worker:lost is 4 (3 in we #1). Not traced.

findings.title: App. E 23's red comes from the consumption half of item 3 variant e
findings.detail: Checked in a scratch copy. With the old crumbs.ts, E23 is green. With only the consumption lines removed (nearest-crumb start kept), E23 is green and so is outdoor/removal.verify. Only retraceResume15 case 1, which asserts consumption explicitly, goes red. So the nearest start alone fixes the removal defect, and the consumption breaks the carrion trail. No arm has measured that variant.
